member.name: P:Azka.NotificationPlatform.API.Models.SendNotificationRequest.NotificationType
member.summary:
The template to send. Choose one of the pre-built templates below:
• UserRegistration — Welcome email/SMS sent on new account creation
• PasswordReset — Password reset instructions
• OrderConfirmation — Order receipt confirmation
• SystemAlert — Critical system alert (Email only)

member.name: P:Azka.NotificationPlatform.API.Models.SendNotificationRequest.Recipient
member.summary:
Recipient address.
• Channel 0 (Email): e.g. user@example.com
• Channel 1 (SMS): E.164 number e.g. +9665XXXXXXXX
• Channel 2 (Push): FCM device token
